rust_api.name: shake128
doc: Hash every row with SHAKE-128.
An `output_length` of zero selects 16 bytes. Output rows are padded to an
eight-byte boundary, matching the OA donor ABI.
# Errors
Rejects invalid shapes, dtypes, shader address limits, allocation or recording failures.

attributes.output_length: u64::try_from(output_length).map_err(|_| Error::invalid_argument("SHAKE output length exceeds u64"))?

rust_api.name: merkle_root
doc: Reduce any non-empty batch of 32-byte leaf hashes to one Merkle root.
Duplicates the final node of each odd level, matching the OA CPU tree.
# Errors
Rejects invalid shapes, dtypes, shader address limits, allocation or recording failures.

rust_api.name: sha224
doc: Hash each U8 `[batch, message_bytes]` row with SHA224.
Returns exact 28-byte digest rows without padding. Empty messages are valid.
Records device work without a host wait. Ordinary Matrix storage is public data;
secret-bearing hashing requires the separate secret execution boundary.
# Errors
Rejects invalid rank, dtype, batch size, address limits, allocation or recording failures.

rust_api.name: merkle_proofs
doc: Build selected SHAKE-256 Merkle inclusion proofs entirely on the device.
`leaves` is U8 `[leaf_count, 32]`; `indices` is rank-one U32. Output is U8
`[proof_count, 16 + depth * 32]`. The little-endian four-word header is
`[version=1, leaf_count, leaf_index, valid]`, followed by siblings bottom-up.
Out-of-range device indices set `valid=0` and zero every sibling. Empty
selections return ready empty storage. No host observation of indices occurs.
# Errors
Rejects metadata, ownership, address limits, allocation or recording failures.

rust_api.name: verify_merkle_proofs
doc: Verify version-one SHAKE-256 inclusion proof frames on the device.
Leaves are U8 `[proof_count, 32]`; proofs have the frame layout returned by
`leaf_count` must come from trusted tree metadata, not the proof header.
`merkle_proofs`. Roots are U8 `[1, 32]` or `[proof_count, 32]`.
Return rank-one U32 flags, exactly zero or one per row. Malformed headers,
indices, duplicate-last paths, tampered leaves or roots return zero. Empty
batches return ready empty storage; no input content is read on the host.
# Errors
Rejects metadata, ownership, address limits, allocation or recording failures.

rust_api.name: poseidon2_babybear16
doc: Apply the pinned Plonky3 babybear16 Poseidon2 field sponge.
U32 rows contain field elements, reduced modulo the named prime.
The OA sponge has capacity eight and explicit length/domain framing.
It is not a claim of NVIDIA sponge wire compatibility.
# Errors
Rejects dtype, rank, width, address limits, allocation or recording failures.
